Micron Announces Major US Investment Boost Amid AI Demand

Micron Technology has significantly increased its planned investment in the United States, committing over $250 billion through 2035. This latest increase builds upon previous announcements, raising the total investment from $200 billion announced in June. The expansion is driven by surging demand for artificial intelligence chips.
